z-m-23-05.title: Kungani x + y = 6, xy = 8 inamapheya amabili ezixazululo, nelicala lepheya elilodwa
z-m-23-05.topic: Inani lezixazululo zezibalo ezihambisanayo ezi-symmetric ezinesamba nomphumela onikeziwe
z-m-23-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi ezibalweni ezihambisanayo lapho u-x no-y beneqhaza elifanayo izixazululo ziza ngamapheya ahleliwe, nokuhlukile (x = y), bese wenza wena isibonelo esinepheya elilodwa lesixazululo ncamashi.
z-m-23-05.material: Ezibalweni ezihambisanayo ezilandelayo, x no-y izinombolo zangempela futhi izixazululo zibalwa njengamapheya ahleliwe (x, y). "(2, 4)" kusho "x ngu-2, y ngu-4" futhi liyipheya elihleliwe elihlukile ku-(4, 2). Izibalo ezihambisanayo: x + y = 6, xy = 8. Siphinde sicabange ngenani lezixazululo zezibalo ezihambisanayo zohlobo x + y = s, xy = p (s no-p izinombolo eziphelele) ngokujwayelekile.
z-m-23-05.prereq.1: Ukuzijwayeza ngezibalo ezihambisanayo ze-quadratic ezingaxazululwa ngokufaka isisho se-linear esishweni se-quadratic
z-m-23-05.prereq.2: Incazelo yepheya elihleliwe ((2, 4) no-(4, 2) amapheya ahleliwe ahlukile)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.prompt: Mangaki amapheya ahleliwe angempela (x, y) anelisa kokubili x + y = 6 no-xy = 8?
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-2, 4, 3 ku-x eyodwa ngesikhathi, khetha u-y ukuze isamba sibe ngu-6, bese uhlola ukuthi isibalo sesibili xy = 8 sisebenza yini.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlela ethebuleni ukuthi (2, 4), (4, 2), no-(2, 2) ngayinye ianelisa zombili izibalo yini.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sibala amapheya amabili ahleliwe anamanani ka-x no-y ashintshiwe njengezixazululo ezihlukile.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.b: (2, 4) kusho "x ngu-2, y ngu-4" futhi (4, 2) kusho "x ngu-4, y ngu-2". Hlola ukuthi amanani ka-x no-y ezibalweni ezimbili ayahluka yini.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.c: Amapheya angu-4: faka u-2 no-4 ngokukhululeka ku-x no-y
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.c: Faka (2, 2) no-(4, 4) ezibalweni ezimbili bese uhlola ukuthi isamba singu-6 yini.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.d: Isibalo ngasinye ngokwaso sinezixazululo ezingapheli, kodwa mangaki amapheya anelisa zombili izibalo ngasikhathi sinye kumele kusetshenzwe ngokwehlukana.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.explain: Uma x inqunyiwe, y inqunywa yisimo sesamba y = 6 − x, futhi kusukela ku-xy = 8, x(6 − x) = 8, okungukuthi, (x − 2)(x − 4) = 0. Uma x = 2, y = 4, futhi uma x = 4, y = 2, ngakho amapheya ahleliwe amapheya amabili (2, 4) no-(4, 2). (2, 2) no-(4, 4) anganesamba esingu-6, ngakho akuyizixazululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.prompt: U-Mina ucabange ngenani lezixazululo zezibalo ezihambisanayo zohlobo x + y = s, xy = p kanje. Yimuphi umugqa wokuqala ongalungile?
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka (3, 3) kusuka emigqeni 3 no-4 ezibalweni ezimbili ukuhlola ukuthi uyasebenza, bese uqhathanisa nesicelo emigqeni 1 no-2.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ukuthi kukhona yini amacala lapho (a, b) no-(b, a), ngokulandelana okushintshiwe, liyipheya elihleliwe elifanayo, nokuthi yini ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b obenza kube njalo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.0: x + y = s, xy = p akushintshi noma u-x no-y bashintshwa. Ngakho uma (a, b) iyisixazululo, (b, a) nayo iyisixazululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.1: Ngakho izixazululo ziza ngamapheya e-(a, b) ne-(b, a) kuphela, futhi inani lezixazululo lihlale lilinganayo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.2: Isibonelo, ku-x + y = 6, xy = 9, ukufaka y = 6 − x ku-xy = 9 kunikeza x(6 − x) = 9, okungukuthi, (x − 3)² = 0.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.3: Khona x = 3, y = 3, ngakho isixazululo siyipheya elilodwa (3, 3).
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.4: Kumele kube lilinganayo kodwa kuyipheya elilodwa, ngakho ukubala emugqeni 3 kuphutha.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 2 uwokuqala ongalungile. (a, b) no-(b, a) liyipheya elihleliwe elifanayo uma a = b, ngakho abenzi ipheya. Umugqa 3 ubalwe kahle njengo-(x − 3)² = 0, futhi (3, 3) yanelisa zombili izibalo (3 + 3 = 6, 3 · 3 = 9). Ngakho nesiphetho emugqeni 5 siphutha.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.prompt: Ku-x + y = s, xy = p (s no-p izinombolo eziphelele), yenza izibalo ezihambisanayo ezingu-3 ezihlukene ezinepheya elilodwa lezixazululo zangempela (x, y) ncamashi. Ngemva kokuzenza, chaza ukuthi kungani kukhona ipheya elilodwa kuphela.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.0: Uma kukhona ipheya elilodwa kuphela, (a, b) no-(b, a), ngokulandelana okushintshiwe, kumele kube yipheya elifanayo. Bhala ukuthi yini ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b obudingekayo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bala isamba nomphumela ka-x, y ngalobo budlelwano (isibonelo, x = y = 3) bese unquma u-s no-p.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Sicela uthathe u-s no-p njengezinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Akukho pheya elilodwa lezixazululo. Kunamapheya amabili angempela (x, y) anelisa zombili izibalo, noma awekho nhlobo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.explain: Uma kukhona ipheya elilodwa kuphela, x = y, ngakho s = 2x, p = x², futhi s² = 4p. Izibonelo: (s, p) = (2, 1) → (1, 1), (4, 4) → (2, 2), (−6, 9) → (−3, −3), (0, 0) → (0, 0). (6, 8) inamapheya amabili, (2, 4) no-(4, 2), futhi (2, 5) ayinazixazululo zangempela (izixazululo eziyinkimbinkimbi kuphela). Kufana nokusho ukuthi isibalo se-quadratic t² − st + p = 0 sinempande ephindwe kabili.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.prompt: Usebenzisa amaqhaza ka-x no-y, chaza ukuthi kungani izibalo ezihambisanayo osanda kuzenza zinepheya elilodwa kuphela lezixazululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi izibalo ezimbili ziba yini uma x no-y bashintshwa.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yini ubudlelwano be-(a, b) ne-(b, a) uma kunepheya elilodwa kuphela lezixazululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: Noma sishintshanisa u-x no-y, ... ngakho ...
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale isimo lapho (a, b) no-(b, a) baba yilokhu okufanayo?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolé ukuthi u-s no-p owenzile baxhumana kanjani naleso simo?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.0: Noma sishintshanisa u-x no-y, izibalo zihlala zinjalo, ngakho uma (a,b) iyisixazululo, (b,a) nayo iyisixazululo. Ukuze kube nepheya elilodwa kuphela, izixazululo ezimbili kumele zifane, ngakho icala kuphela ngu-a=b, okungukuthi, x=y.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.1: Uma isixazululo ngu-(a, b), khona (b, a), ngokulandelana okushintshiwe, nayo iyisixazululo, ngakho ngokuvamile ziza ngamapheya. Ukuze kube nepheya elilodwa kuphela, izinombolo ezimbili kumele zifane, ngakho icala s=2x, p=x² kuphela lisebenza.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Ixhumanise yonke indlela ezibalweni ezino-s no-p.

z-m-23-01.title: x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0: ukuhlola isixazululo esithi kunezimpande ezingempela ezine
z-m-23-01.topic: Ukuhlulela inani lezimpande ezingempela ze-quartic equation ngefomu le-quadratic ku-x²
z-m-23-01.goal: Ku-quartic equation exazululwe ngokuvumela u-x² abe uhlamvu olusha, hlola ibanga lapho inani loluhlamvu olusha lingenza u-x ongempela ukuthola iphutha esixazululweni, bese uchaza izimo lapho uphawu lwama-coefficient kuphela lunquma inani lezimpande ezingempela.
z-m-23-01.material: UYeongseo waxazulula i-quartic equation u-x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0 ukuthola zonke izixazululo zayo ezingempela (izimpande ezingempela). Lapha, izimpande ezingempela zisho kuphela izixazululo eziyizinombolo ezingempela, futhi izixazululo ezingekho ngempela azibalwa. (x⁴ ifundwa "x to the fourth power" no-x² ifundwa "x squared".)
z-m-23-01.prereq.0: U-H1 kulo msebenzi uphawula kuphela ubunzima balolu hlobo lokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi uhlelo lwezifundo lwabela lokhu okuqukethwe eBangeni 1 lesikole esiphakeme. Ukulandelana kokufunda okucatshangwayo: abafundi osebevele bafunda ama-quadratic equation, ama-quadratic inequality, nobudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient.
z-m-23-01.prereq.1: Ukuzijwayeza ukuxazulula ngokwenza izici i-quadratic expression ku-x²
z-m-23-01.prereq.2: Ukuhlulela izimpawu usebenzisa isamba nomkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili ze-quadratic equation
z-m-23-01.prereq.3: Ukuhlukanisa izinombolo ezingempela nezingekho ngempela (akukho nombolo engempela enika inani elinegethivu uma yenziwa isikwele)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umugqa esixazululweni sikaYeongseo owokuqala ophosile? Khetha umugqa owodwa. (Amaphutha alandela kuwo achazwa ndawonye encazelweni.)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka inani elivela emgqeni ngamunye ngqo ku-equation yokuqala u-x⁴ + x² − 6 bese uhlola eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi iba ngu-0 yini.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngebanga lamanani lapho u-x² endaweni luka-t angathatha khona ku-x ongempela, bese uqhathanisa umugqa 3 nomugqa 4.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuvumela u-x² abe ngu-t kunika u-t² + t − 6 = 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.3: Kusuka ku-x² = −3, u-x = ±√3, futhi kusuka ku-x² = 2, u-x = ±√2.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 ngowokuqala ophosile. Inombolo engempela u-x ingu-0 okungenani uma yenziwa isikwele, ngakho akukho u-x ongempela onu-x² = −3. Ngakho u-±√3 akuzona izimpande ezingempela (uma ufaka u-x = √3 ku-equation yokuqala, 9 + 3 − 6 = 6 ≠ 0). U-"four" emgqeni 5 uphosile nawo ngenxa yalokhu, futhi izimpande ezingempela ziyizimbili, u-−√2 no-√2. Imigqa 1 kuya ku-3 ilungile.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.prompt: Kwizinombolo eziphelele u-p no-q, ku-x⁴ + px² + q = 0, uma wazi kuphela ukuthi u-q < 0 futhi ungazi u-p, zingaki izimpande ezingempela ezihlukile?
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala futhi uqhathanise izimpande ezingempela ngqo kuma-equation amathathu lapho u-q efana ngo-−4 no-p engu-−5, 0, 3.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala njenge-equation ukuthi umkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili ze-quadratic equation ku-t=x² uhlobana kanjani no-q, bese uhlola uphawu.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.a: 4: inani ngalinye lamabili luka-x² linika u-x ongempela ababili
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.a: Inani lapho u-x² enegethivu alinikezi u-x ongempela. Qala ngokubheka uphawu lwamanani u-x² angawathatha.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.b: 2: inani elilodwa kuphela lamanani luka-x² linika u-x ongempela
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sisebenza ukuthi amanani amabili luka-x² anezimpawu ezinjani.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.c: 0: u-x⁴ no-x² bangu-0 okungenani, ngakho isamba sabo asikwazi ukuba ngu-0
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.c: Uma ufaka u-x = 0, inani lesisho ngu-q, onegethivu. Bheka ushintsho lophawu ukubona ukuthi kukhona yini indawo lapho inani lesisho lingu-0.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.d: Akunakwaziwa: kuye ngenani luka-p, kungelinye lika-0, 2, noma 4
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sicabanga ukuthi inani luka-p liyadingeka. Kodwa qala ngokuhlola ukuthi kukhona yini iqiniso elilungiswa ngu-q < 0 kuphela noma ngabe u-p uyini.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.explain: Umkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili luka-t² + pt + q = 0 onu-t = x² ngu-q < 0, ngakho impande eyodwa iyiphozithivu futhi enye inegethivu (i-discriminant u-p² − 4q nayo ihlala iyiphozithivu). Kuphela u-t oyiphozithivu unika u-x ongempela ababili, ngakho noma u-p uyini, kunezimpande ezingempela ezihlukile ezingu-2.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.prompt: Chaza, usebenzisa uphawu luka-t (= x²), ukuthi kungani kunezimpande ezingempela ezingu-2 noma ngabe u-p uyini uma u-q < 0, bese unikeza isibonelo esisodwa ngezinombolo lapho inani lezimpande ezingempela lincike ku-p uma u-q > 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala emshweni owodwa iqiniso lokuthi umkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili luka-t ngu-q nophawu luka-q.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.1: Njengezibonelo zika-q > 0, xazulula u-p = −5, q = 4 no-p = 1, q = 1 bese ubala izimpande ezingempela, bese ubhala eyodwa yazo.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma u-q < 0, umkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili luka-t ngu-... ngakho ...
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi izimpande ezimbili luka-t zinezimpawu ezihlukile uma u-q < 0 njengesizathu?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubhale ukuxhumana okuthi "kuphela u-t oyiphozithivu unika u-x ongempela"?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uxazulule isibonelo sika-q > 0 osinikeze wena futhi wahlola inani lezimpande ezingempela?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.0: U-q ungumkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili luka-t²+pt+q=0 futhi unegethivu, ngakho u-t oyedwa uyiphozithivu futhi oyedwa unegethivu. Kusuka ku-x²=iphozithivu kunu-x ongempela ababili, futhi kusuka ku-x²=inegethivu akukho u-x ongempela, ngakho njalo kunezimpande ezingempela ezingu-2. Uma u-q>0, u-x⁴−5x²+4=0 unu-t=1, 4, ngakho izimpande ezingempela ezingu-4, kodwa u-x⁴+x²+1=0 akanazimpande ezingempela.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma uvumela u-t=x², umkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili unegethivu, ngakho izimpawu zazo ziyahluka. U-t onegethivu akakwazi ukuvela esikweleni, ngakho kuphela u-x ababili abavela ku-t oyiphozithivu bayizimpande ezingempela. Noma u-q eyiphozithivu, kuncike ku-p: ngo-p=−2, q=1 kunezimpande ezingempela ezingu-2, futhi ngo-p=3, q=2 kunezimpande ezingempela ezingu-0.

z-m-23-02.title: Uma impande eyodwa ingu-1 + i, enye impande inqunyiwe?
z-m-23-02.topic: Izimo ezidingekayo ukulungisa enye impande ku-quadratic equation enempande engekho ngempela
z-m-23-02.goal: Hlukanisa ulwazi oludingekayo nolwazi olushodayo ukulungisa enye impande uma impande eyodwa ingekho ngempela, bese wenza izibonelo zakho eziphikisayo lapho ama-coefficient engase ayizinombolo ezingempela.
z-m-23-02.material: Impande eyodwa ye-quadratic equation u-x² + px + q = 0 ngu-1 + i. (U-i yinombolo isikwele sayo esingu-−1 futhi ifundwa "eye".) UMina wathi, "Enye impande ngu-1 − i," futhi uDoyun wathi, "Lokho kuphela akukwazi ukulungisa enye impande." Akukashiwo ukuthi u-p no-q bangezinombolo ezinhlobo luni.
z-m-23-02.prereq.1: Ukwengeza nokuphindaphinda izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi, ingxenye engempela nengxenye engekho ngempela
z-m-23-02.prereq.2: Ubudlelwano bokuthi isamba sezimpande ezimbili ze-quadratic equation singu-−p futhi umkhiqizo ungu-q
z-m-23-02.prereq.3: Incazelo ye-discriminant (izinhlobo zezimpande uma ama-coefficient engempela)
z-m-23-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphandle kweqiniso lokuthi impande eyodwa ye-quadratic equation u-x² + px + q = 0 ngu-1 + i, yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olungalungisa enye impande ibe yinye ncamashi? Khetha lonke ulwazi olulungisa ngaleyo ndlela.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kunketho ngayinye, bheka eyodwa ngesikhathi ngezinombolo isibonelo esinelisa lesi simo kodwa esinenye impande ehlukile.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa ubudlelwano bokuthi isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-−p ukubhala ngqo enye impande kunketho ngayinye.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.a: Iqiniso lokuthi isamba singempela lodwa alikwazi ukunciphisa enye impande ibe yinye. Bhala enye impande uma isamba singu-3 nalapho singu-2.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo siyazi ukuthi isimo kuma-coefficient sikunciphisa kanjani umumo wezimpande.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.c: Kusuka ekutheni i-discriminant inegethivu kuphela, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi izimpande zifika ngamapheya yini. Bala i-discriminant ecaleni lapho izimpande zingu-1 + i no-1.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sisebenzisa ubudlelwano bokuthi isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-−p.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.explain: Uma u-p no-q bengempela, impande engekho ngempela ifika ngepheya ne-conjugate complex number yayo, ngakho enye impande inqunyiwe njengo-1 − i. Noma ukwazi inani luka-p kulungisa enye impande ngoba isamba singu-−p (uma u-p = −3, khona-ke 3 − (1 + i) = 2 − i). Ulwazi lokuthi isamba singempela alwanele, ngoba enye impande ingaba ngu-1 − i noma u-2 − i. Noma i-discriminant inegethivu, kukhona icala lapho izimpande zingu-1 + i no-1 (p = −(2 + i), q = 1 + i, p² − 4q = −1), ngakho akunqunyiwe.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.prompt: Ubhala enye impande njengo-m + ni (u-m no-n bayizinombolo eziphelele), yenza izibonelo ezingu-3 ezihlukile lapho u-p engempela kodwa u-q engekho ngempela. (Isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-−p futhi umkhiqizo ungu-q. U-i yinombolo isikwele sayo esingu-−1.)
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi ingxenye engekho ngempela yesamba sezimpande ezimbili (1 + i) + (m + ni) kumele ibe yinani luni ukuze u-p abe ngempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ngo-n ohlangabezana nesimo sengxenye engekho ngempela, andisa umkhiqizo u-(1 + i)(m + ni), uthole u-m owenza ingxenye engekho ngempela ibe ngu-0, bese ugwema lowo m.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.var.n: Ingxenye engekho ngempela n yenye impande
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Isamba sezimpande ezimbili u-(1 + m) + (1 + n)i asiyona ingempela. U-p naye akayona ingempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Ingxenye engekho ngempela yomkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili akusiyo u-0, ngakho u-q akayona ingempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ingxenye engekho ngempela yomkhiqizo wezimpande ezimbili u-(m − n) + (m + n)i ingu-0, ngakho u-q ungempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuze isamba sibe ngempela, ingxenye engekho ngempela u-1 + n kumele ibe ngu-0, ngakho u-n = −1. Bese umkhiqizo ungu-(m + 1) + (m − 1)i, ngakho uma u-m ≠ 1, u-q akayona ingempela. Isibonelo: uma enye impande ingu-2 − i, khona-ke u-p = −3 (ngempela) no-q = (1 + i)(2 − i) = 3 + i (akayona ngempela). Uma u-m = 1, enye impande ingu-1 − i no-q=2, ongempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.prompt: Chazela umngane. Ungasho ini ngenye impande ye-quadratic equation enempande eyodwa u-1 + i, uma kukhona isitatimende esithi "ama-coefficient u-p no-q angempela" nalapho kungekho?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala emshweni owodwa enye impande uma kukhona isimo sokuthi ama-coefficient angempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.1: Uma kungekho simo, khumbula isibonelo owenza ngaphambilini (u-2 − i njalonjalo) bese ubhala emshweni owodwa ukuthi enye impande akuyona into eyodwa kuphela engenzeka.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma u-p no-q bengempela, ... Uma kungekho sitatimende esinjalo, ...
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale enye impande ngokuqondile uma ama-coefficient engempela?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uyazi okungenani isibonelo esisodwa (isibonelo, u-2 − i noma u-1) esingaba yinye impande uma kungekho simo?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uxhumanise ngamazwi akho ukuthi kungani isimo esithi "ama-coefficient angempela" sidingeka?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.0: Uma u-p no-q bengempela, impande engekho ngempela ifika ngepheya ne-conjugate yayo, ngakho enye impande ngu-1−i. Uma kungekho sitatimende esinjalo, kunezinketho eziningana njengo-2−i noma u-1, ngakho enye impande ayikwazi ukulungiswa.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.1: Uma ama-coefficient engempela, i-conjugate complex number u-1−i luka-1+i yenye impande. Uma kungekho simo kuma-coefficient, ingashintsha, njengo-2−i uma isamba singu-3 no-1−i uma isamba singu-2, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi iyinani elilodwa.

z-m-23-06.title: Ukuxazulula (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) ngokuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili
z-m-23-06.topic: Amacala lapho isixazululo siphutha esibalweni esinesici esivamile ezinhlangothini zombili
z-m-23-06.goal: Qonda ukuthi kungani, esibalweni lapho isici esifanayo siphindaphindwa ezinhlangothini zombili, icala lapho lowo sici singu-0 kumele lihlolwe ngokwehlukana, bese ukhetha futhi wenze izibalo lapho indlela yokuxazulula iphutha izixazululo nalezo lapho ingaziphutha khona.
z-m-23-06.material: Umfundi uxazulule isibalo (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2). x yinombolo yangempela futhi izixazululo nazo ziyakhawulelwa ezinombolweni zangempela. (Indlela yokufunda: "x minus 2 times x minus 5 equals 3 times x minus 2".)
z-m-23-06.thinking.2: Ukwenza wena izibonelo eziphikisayo (izibonelo lapho isixazululo siphuthelwa)
z-m-23-06.prereq.2: Ukuhlola isixazululo sesibalo ngokusifaka esibalweni sokuqala
z-m-23-06.s.s1.prompt: Umfundi uxazulule isibalo (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) kanje. Yimuphi umugqa wokuqala onenkinga?
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi yikuphi ukubala okwenze umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo kusuka kowandulelayo, bese uhlola ukuthi lokho kubala kungasetshenziswa kuwo wonke u-x.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uhlukanisa, bhala ukuthi yimaphi amanani isihlukanisi okumele singabi wona, bese uhlola ukuthi leyo nani ingenzeka ku-x kule nkinga.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(x − 2) kunikeza x − 5 = 3.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.3: Ukufaka x = 8 esibalweni sokuqala kunikeza 6 · 3 = 18 no-3 · 6 = 18, ngakho kuyasebenza.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho isixazululo esisodwa salesi sibalo ngu-x = 8.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.explain: Inkinga iqala ukuvela emugqeni 2. Uma x = 2, khona x − 2 ingu-0, ngakho kufana nokuhlukanisa ngo-0. Uma ufaka x = 2 esibalweni sokuqala, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0, ngakho x = 2 nayo iyisixazululo. Ukuhlola emugqeni 4 kubonisa kuphela ukuthi x = 8 iyisixazululo futhi akusho ukuthi azikho ezinye izixazululo. Ngakho "esisodwa kuphela" emugqeni 5 siphutha, futhi izixazululo zangempela ngu-2 no-8.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.prompt: Zonke izibalo ezilandelayo zinesici esifanayo (x − 1) esiphindaphindwayo ezinhlangothini zombili. Yiluphi olungalahlekelwa isixazululo nhlobo uma luxazululwa ngokuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(x − 1)?
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x = 1 ngqo ku-isibalo ngasinye bese uhlola ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili ziyalingana yini.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kusibalo ngasinye, linganisa izisho ezimbili ezisele ngemva kokukhipha (x − 1) bese uqhathanisa ukuthi isixazululo salo singu-1 yini.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.a: Lesi yisinqumo esiqhathanise ukuthi x = 1 iyisixazululo nokuthi ingaphakathi yini nezixazululo zesisho esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.b: Faka x = 1 ukubona ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0 yini, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi isixazululo sesisho esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa, x + 2 = 4, singu-1 yini.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.c: x = 1 iyisixazululo, kodwa isixazululo esisodwa sesisho esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa, 3 = x + 4, ngu-−1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.d: x = 1 iyisixazululo, kodwa isixazululo esisodwa sesisho esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa, x − 3 = 2, ngu-5.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.explain: Ezibalweni zonke ezine, ukufaka x = 1 kwenza izinhlangothi zombili zibe ngu-0, ngakho x = 1 iyisixazululo. Uma isixazululo sesibalo esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa singu-1, akukho sixazululo esiphuthelwayo. a inikeza u-2 kusukela ku-x + 2 = 4, b inikeza u-−1 kusukela ku-3 = x + 4, no-c inikeza u-5 kusukela ku-x − 3 = 2, ngakho zonke ziphutha x = 1. d inikeza x = 1 kusukela ku-x + 3 = 4, ngakho akukho sixazululo esiphuthelwayo, futhi njengoba kungu-(x − 1)² = 0, isixazululo esisodwa singu-1.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.prompt: Ezibalweni zohlobo (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) (a, b, c zinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9), yenza izibalo ezingu-3 ezihlukene lapho indlela yokuxazulula yokuhlukanisa ngo-(x − a) iphutha isixazululo esisodwa. Isibalo esifanayo esibhalwe ngokuhlukile (u-a ofanayo no-b + c ofanayo) sibalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhethe u-a bese uhlola ukuthi x = a iyisixazululo sesibalo sokuqala, bese ukhetha b no-c ukuze isixazululo sika-x − b = c, esitholwa ngokulinganisa izici ezisele, sihluke ku-a.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uma wenza ama-(a, b, c) amaningana, hlola ukuthi lawo anoa ofanayo kanye no-b + c ofanayo kuphela ayisibalo esifanayo, bese ukhetha u-a noma b + c ohlukile.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c2: a, b, c kumele zibe kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.ok.c3: x = a iyisixazululo kodwa ihluke esixazululweni x = b + c sesibalo esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa, ngakho iyaphuthelwa.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c3: x = a ifana nesixazululo b + c sesibalo esisele ngemva kokuhlukanisa, ngakho akukho sixazululo esiphuthelwayo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) ngu-(x − a)(x − b − c) = 0, ngakho izixazululo ngu-x = a no-x = b + c. Indlela yokuhlukanisa ithola kuphela u-x = b + c. Uma u-a ≠ b + c, isixazululo u-a siyashiywa. Izibonelo: (a, b, c) = (2, 5, 3) → izixazululo 2 no-8, (1, 4, 0) → 1 no-4. Ku-(2, −1, 3), b + c = 2 = a, ngakho isixazululo kuphela ngu-2 futhi akukho okushiyiwe.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi isixazululo esishiyiwe siyinani lini nokuthi kungani le ndlela yokuxazulula ingasetshenziswa njengoba injalo kuleli nani.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi isisho u-x − a singu-0 kunani lini lika-x.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi uhlangothi ngalunye luba yini uma ufaka lowo x ku-equation yokuqala.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngqo ukuthi isixazululo esishiyiwe ngu-x = a?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uxhumanise iqiniso lokuthi u-x − a ungu-0 kuleli nani nokuthi "awukwazi ukuhlukanisa ngo-0"?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.0: Isixazululo esishiyiwe ngu-x=a. Uma x=a, khona-ke u-x−a ungu-0 futhi asikwazi ukuhlukanisa ngo-0, ngakho kumele sihlole leli cala ngokwehlukana.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.1: Isixazululo u-x=a, lapho isici esiyisithasiselo u-x−a singu-0, siyisixazululo se-equation yokuqala, kodwa indlela ihlukanisa ngesisho esingu-0 lapho, ngakho lesi sixazululo siyanyamalala. Kumele ufake leli nani ku-equation yokuqala ngokwehlukana.

z-m-23-03.title: Ibhola elilahliwe liphansi nini, ku-6 m noma ngaphansi?
z-m-23-03.topic: Ukusebenzisa ama-quadratic inequality: ukucabangela nebanga loguquguquko
z-m-23-03.goal: Esimweni esenziwe imodeli nge-quadratic inequality, ungathathi isixazululo sesisho njengempendulo njengoba sinjalo, kodwa usihumushe ndawonye nebanga lapho imodeli isebenza khona, bese wenza wena amanani afanelana nezimo.
z-m-23-03.material: Ibhola lalahlwa liya phezulu liphuma ekuphakameni okungu-1 m ngaphezu komhlaba. Ukuphakama u-t amasekhondi ngemuva kokulahla kunikezwa ngu-h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1 (inyunithi: m), futhi lesi sisho singasetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi ibhola indiza (kusukela ekuhambeni kokulahla kuze kube yilapho lithinta umhlaba). Ungazinaki ukumelana komoya.

z-m-23-03.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi ukuphakama kwebhola elilahliwe kuphansi nini, ku-6 m noma ngaphansi. Bheka ukuthi isahlulelo sakho siguquka kanjani isikhathi ngasinye lapho kudalulwa ucezu lolwazi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuphakama ngesikhathi ngasinye ethebuleni no-6 m bese ukhomba ukuthi yimaphi amarowu angu-6 m noma ngaphansi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka izikhathi ezingekho ethebuleni (0.5 s, 3.5 s) esishweni bese uhlola ukuthi ukuphakama kungu-6 m noma ngaphansi.

z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ukuphakama kungu-6 m noma ngaphansi nini ngemuva kokulahla? Bheka ithebula bese wenza isibikezelo kuqala.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ubheka ithebula, ukuphakama kuphansi ku-1 m ku-0 s nasku-4 s, futhi u-16 m noma ngaphezulu kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-3 s. Ngakho kubukeka ukuthi izikhathi eziphansi zimbili, eduze nokuqala naseduze nokugcina. Kodwa ithebula libonisa kuphela amasekhondi aphelele, ngakho udinga isisho ukuthola ncamashi lapho imikhawulo ikhona khona.

Kodwa u-t ≥ 3.73 akanakuphela, ngakho ufaka izikhathi ngemuva kokuba ibhola lithinte umhlaba. Lesi sisho singasetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi ibhola indiza, ngakho udinga ukucabangela ibanga luka-t.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yebo. Isixazululo se-inequality siphumile, ngakho siyimpendulo njengoba injalo
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sithathe isixazululo sesisho kuphela. Funda futhi umusho wokuqala wolwazi ukubona ukuthi lesi sisho singasetshenziswa ngaziphi izikhathi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Sidinga ukuhlola ukuthi ibanga luka-t linqunyelwe ngesikhathi ibhola indiza yini
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo siyazi ibanga lapho isisho singasetshenziswa khona.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isixazululo kungenzeka silungile. Ithebula nezikhathi ezimbili akuhambisani
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ithebula (u-0 s no-4 s baphansi) nomphumela (eduze nokuqala, eduze nokugcina) empeleni kuhambisana kahle. Linganisela amanani ezimpande bese uwaqhathanisa nethebula.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Qala ngokuqhathanisa ngokuqonda ngokufaka u-t = 0.2 no-3.8 esishweni ukubona ukuthi ukuphakama kungu-6 m noma ngaphansi yini
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sihlola umphumela ngethebula nokulinganisela.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Isikhathi ibhola elithinta ngaso umhlaba yilapho u-h(t) = 0. Kusuka ku-−5t² + 20t + 1 = 0, u-t = 2 + √4.2 ≈ 4.05 (s). Ngakho izikhathi lapho ibhola indiza ngu-0 ≤ t ≤ 4.05.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kufanelekile kanjani ukubhala izikhathi lapho "ukuphakama kungu-6 m noma ngaphansi"?
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Izikhathi eziphansi ngu-0 ≤ t ≤ 0.27 (cishe u-0.27 s) no-3.73 ≤ t ≤ 4.05 (cishe u-0.32 s). Ndawonye kungu-0.59 s cishe, okufushane.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ibanga lesikhathi alibhalwanga. Lingafundwa njengebhola lisekhona ngemva kwe-4.05 s.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ufunde isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic t² − 4t + 1 ≥ 0 njengophakathi kwezimpande ezimbili. Hlola ngeqiniso lokuthi ukuphakama ku-2 s kungu-21 m.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sibhale isixazululo sesisho ndawonye nebanga lapho ibhola liandiswa khona.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uphoqe u-4 s njengesikhathi lapho lithinta khona phansi. Ku-4 s ukuphakama kungu-1 m, ngakho ibhola lisandiza.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.reflect: Isibikezelo sakho sokuqala se-"izikhathi ezimbili, eduze nokuqala neduze nokuphela" sahlala kuze kube sekugcineni. Okushintshile kwakuyizinani eziqondile zemikhawulo nephuzu lokuthi kumele uhlole ibanga elingathathwa ukuhlukahluka ngaphambi kokuthatha isixazululo sesisho njengoba sinjalo. Bheka emuva ukuthi ubuhloliwe yini ibanga lapho isisho sisetshenziswa khona ngaphambi kokubhala isixazululo sesisho.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala izikhathi ezintathu ezihlukene t (s) lapho ukuphakama kungu-6 m noma ngaphansi futhi ibhola lisandiza.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.0: Faka isikhathi esisodwa ngemva nje kokuphonsa nesisodwa ngaphambi nje kokuwa esishweni bese ubala ukuphakama.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.1: Uma ukuphakama okubalile kukhulu kuno-6, hambisa isikhathi siye ku-0 noma siye ku-4 bese ubala futhi.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c1: t kumele ibe ngemva kwesikhathi sokuphonsa (0 s).
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuphakama kuncane kuno-0. Isikhathi ngemva kokuthi ibhola selithinte phansi.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuphakama kuphakeme kuno-6 m. Kufake esishweni bese ubala.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.explain: Izikhathi eziphansi ngu-0 ≤ t ≤ 0.27 noma 3.73 ≤ t ≤ 4.05. Isibonelo, t = 0 (1 m), 0.2 (4.8 m), 3.8 (4.8 m), 4 (1 m) kufanele izimo. t = 0.3 noma 3.7 kunikeza u-6.55 m, okungaphezu kuka-6 m, futhi t = 5 inikeza ukuphakama okungu-−24, ngaphansi komhlaba, ngakho ibhola selithinte phansi.

z-m-23-04.prereq.0: U-H1 kulo msebenzi uphawula kuphela ubunzima balolu hlobo lokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi uhlelo lwezifundo lwabela lokhu okuqukethwe eBangeni 1 lesikole esiphakeme. Ukulandelana kokufunda okucatshangwayo: abafundi osebevele bafunda ama-quadratic equation, ama-quadratic inequality, nobudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient.
z-m-23-04.title: Ithebula lamanani lingakwazi ukumisa izixazululo eziphelele zika-f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.topic: Ukwahlulela izixazululo eziphelele zokungalingani kwe-quadratic usebenzisa ithebula lamanani nophawu lomsebenzi we-quadratic
z-m-23-04.goal: Hlulela isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic ngoshintsho lophawu ethebuleni lamanani omsebenzi, hlela izicelo ezingenakwenziwa ngethebula kuphela, bese uchaza ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezinquma isiphetho.
z-m-23-04.material:
Umsebenzi f(x) = ax² + bx + c uwumsebenzi we-quadratic i-coefficient ka-x² yawo a iyiphozithivu, kodwa asazi amanani ka-a, b, c. Konke esikwaziyo ithebula lamanani elingezansi, futhi wonke u-x ethebuleni ayizinombolo eziphelele.
x: −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, −1, −3, −3, −1, 3
Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinombolo eziphelele x ezanelisa f(x) < 0? (Ethebuleni, umugqa ophezulu ngu-x futhi umugqa ophansi unani lika-f(x), futhi izinombolo ezindaweni ezifanayo zibhanqwe.)
z-m-23-04.prereq.1: Isimo segrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic (uphawu lika-a nesiqondiso esivulekela kuso)
z-m-23-04.prereq.2: Ukuhlangana komsebenzi we-quadratic ne-x-axis, ne-axis ye-symmetry
z-m-23-04.prereq.3: Ukufunda isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic kusukela kugrafu
z-m-23-04.s.s1.prompt: Uma usebenzisa kuphela ithebula futhi ungatholi isisho, yisiphi isitatimende esingamiswa mayelana nezinombolo eziphelele x ezanelisa f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ethebuleni, phawula phakathi kwamanani ka-x athini f ishintsha ngawo isuka kuphozithivu iye kunegethivu nokusuka kunegethivu iye kuphozithivu.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngesimo somsebenzi we-quadratic onge-a > 0, cabanga ukuthi x enamanani angaphansi kuka-0 yenza amabanga amangaki, bese uqhathanisa nezinombolo eziphelele ngaphandle kwethebula.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.a: Ezimbili kuphela, 1 no-2. Yilapho inani lincane kakhulu ethebuleni
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sibheka kuphela lapho inani lincane kakhulu khona. f(x) < 0 kusho wonke u-x onamanani angaphansi kuka-0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.b: Zonke izinombolo eziphelele eziyisithupha ethebuleni, kusukela ku-−1 kuya ku-4
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sibona wonke u-x ethebuleni njengezixazululo. Hlola futhi ukuthi ikholomu enenani elingu-3 yanelisa f(x) < 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.c: 0, 1, 2, 3, futhi izinombolo eziphelele ngaphandle kwethebula azizona izixazululo
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sisebenzisa kokubili ushintsho lophawu ethebuleni nesimo somsebenzi we-quadratic.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.d: Amanani angaba negethivu nakwezinombolo eziphelele ngaphandle kwethebula, ngakho akunakumiswa
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sithi amanani angekho ethebuleni awaziwa. Cabanga ukuthi izimo zokuthi kungumsebenzi we-quadratic futhi a > 0 zikutshela ini ngaphandle kwethebula.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.explain: f(−1) = 3 > 0 no-f(0) = −1 < 0, ngakho uphawu lushintsha phakathi kuka-−1 no-0, futhi f(3) = −1 < 0 no-f(4) = 3 > 0, ngakho lushintsha phakathi kuka-3 no-4. Kumsebenzi we-quadratic onge-a > 0, u-x one-f(x) < 0 wakha ibanga elilodwa, ngakho isixazululo siphakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili, futhi izinombolo eziphelele ngu-0, 1, 2, 3. (Uma uthola isisho f(x) = x² − 3x − 1 bese uhlola, uthola isiphetho esifanayo.)
z-m-23-04.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi uqonde kanje kusukela ethebuleni elingenhla. Khetha umugqa ongalungile, isicelo esingenakwenziwa ngethebula kuphela.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ukhuluma ngamanani abhalwe ethebuleni kuphela noma ngamanani ku-x engekho ethebuleni.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kusukela eqinisweni f(1) = f(2), bhala ukuthi igrafu iyi-symmetric nge-x muphi, bese uqhathanisa inani ku-x leyo nezinye izinani ethebuleni.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.0: f(−1) = 3 > 0 no-f(0) = −1 < 0, ngakho uphawu lwenani lika-f lushintsha phakathi kuka-−1 no-0.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.1: f(3) = −1 < 0 no-f(4) = 3 > 0, ngakho uphawu nalo lushintsha phakathi kuka-3 no-4.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.2: Kumsebenzi we-quadratic onge-a > 0, u-x onamanani angaphansi kuka-0 wakha ibanga elilodwa, ngakho leli banga lilele phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili angenhla.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.3: Ngakho izinombolo eziphelele x ezine-f(x) < 0 ngu-0, 1, 2, 3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.4: Futhi, f(1) = f(2) = −3, ngakho inani elincane kakhulu lika-f lingu-−3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 5 awulungile. Awukwazi ukusho inani elincane kakhulu ngokubheka kuphela amanani ezinombolweni eziphelele x. Uma f(1) = f(2), i-axis ye-symmetry ngu-x = 1.5 futhi okuncane kakhulu kwenzeka lapho. Kuleli thebula, f(x) = x² − 3x − 1, ngakho f(1.5) = −3.25, okuncane kuno-−3. Imigqa 1 kuya ku-4 ingasho ngokulungile usebenzisa ithebula kuphela nesimo a > 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma kwakunikeziwe ithebula elingenhla kuphela, ngaphandle kwesimo "umsebenzi we-quadratic one-a > 0", ubungakwazi ukumisa ukuthi u-0, 1, 2, 3 kuphela izinombolo eziphelele ezine-f(x) < 0? Bhala isizathu nokuthi yimuphi ulwazi olungadingeka ukumisa.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi amanani angaba noma yini phakathi kwezinombolo eziphelele x zethebula (phakathi kuka-1 no-2) nangaphandle kwethebula (5 noma ngaphezulu), bese ucabanga ngamacala lapho izinombolo eziphelele ezine-f(x) < 0 ziyanda.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka emuva ukuthi yiziphi izinqumo ezisebenzise isimo "umsebenzi we-quadratic one-a > 0" ezinyathelweni zangaphambilini.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi yini ehlukile phakathi kokuba nesimo sokuba ngumsebenzi we-quadratic nokungabi naso?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucabange ngokukhonkolo ukuthi amanani angaba yini phakathi kwamanani ethebula (phakathi kuka-1 no-2) noma ngaphandle kwethebula (5 noma ngaphezulu, −2 noma ngaphansi)?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale okungenani ulwazi olulodwa oludingekayo ukumisa?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.0: Akunakumiswa. Ithebula libonisa amanani ezinombolweni eziphelele ezimbalwa kuphela, ngakho angazi ukuthi amanani ashintsha kanjani phakathi kuka-1 no-2 noma ngaphandle kwethebula (5 noma ngaphezulu). Kuphela ngesimo sokuthi kungumsebenzi we-quadratic one-a>0 lapho singasho ukuthi ibanga lapho iyinegethivu libanga elilodwa.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.1: Cha. Uma kungeyona umsebenzi we-quadratic kodwa omunye umsebenzi odlula emaphoyinteni ethebula, ungaba negethivu ezindaweni ezifana no-5 noma u-−2, futhi ungaphakama ube yiphozithivu phakathi kuka-1 no-2. Singamisa kuphela ngesimo sokuba ngumsebenzi we-quadratic noma amanani amaningi ngaphandle kwethebula.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Futhi inikeze amanani angaphandle kwethebula njengolwazi olwengeziwe.
